title: The Telangana Revenue Summonses Act, 1869.
full_text: The Telangana Revenue Summonses Act, 1869. Rules Regulations Notifications Orders Circulars Ordinance Statutes SectionsScheduleAnnexureAppendixFormsActdetails Act ID: 18693 Act Number: 3 Enactment Date: 1869-03-09 Act Year: 1869 Short Title: The Telangana Revenue Summonses Act, 1869. Long Title: An Act to empower Revenue-Officers, to summon persons to attend at their Kachahris for the settlement of matters connected with Revenue administration. Department: Department of Revenue Type: STATE Location: Telangana TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles TitleFiles Show all section Section 1. Revenue officers empowered to summon persons to appear or to produce documents. Section 2. Terms of summons. Section 3. Service of summons. Section 4. Persons summoned to produce may send documents by third party. Section 5. When personal attendance or witnesses dispensed with. Section 6. Officers to have powers of a civil court in certain matters. Section 7. Power to make rules.
